Job Summary 

 The Applied AI/ML Software Developer will join our thermal engineering team for the development of AI/ML-powered control systems, digital twins, and simulation infrastructure for data center cooling equipment.

 You will work closely with mechanical and controls engineers to help develop and implement intelligent system control strategies.  You will work primarily in Python and C/C++ on Linux-based platforms, leveraging containerized development environments and CI/CD pipelines.

 Responsibilities : 

 Simulation Development: 

 
 Support simulation environments used for controls development and testing purposes, utilizing simulation industry standards such as FMU/FMI and equipment reduced Order Models (ROMs).

 Creation of Reduced Order Models (ROMs) based on real or synthetic unit/system/environment data.

 Support Digital Twin development and implementation

 Maintain FMU packages for simulation deployment

 
 Control Development 

 
 Investigate alternate control strategies involving machine learning models, reinforcement learning, model-predictive control (MPC), and other data based solutions

 Develop, train, and validate ML models for adaptive control of thermal systems, predictive maintenance, and anomaly detection

 Deploy ML inference pipelines on Linux-based industrial platforms

 
 System Integration 

 
 Interface with equipment and simulations utilizing various industrial protocols, pub-sub messaging, API's (Modbus, CAN, MQTT, REST, HTTP/REST etc.)

 
 Requirements : 

 
 Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree (MS or higher) in Computer Science and Engineering or Electrical and Computer Engineering, with a strong emphasis on software

 2+ Years experience in similar position 

 Python Programming 

 C/C++ Programming

 TensorFlow or PyTorch

 Git/GitLab

 Linux

 Docker/Containerization

 Industrial Communication Protocols, including MQTT, Modbus, and CAN

 
 The successful candidate will embrace Vertiv’s Core Principals & Behaviors to help execute our Strategic Priorities.  

 OUR CORE PRINCIPALS : Safety .  Integrity.  Respect.  Teamwork.  Inclusion. 

 OUR STRATEGIC PRIORITIES 

 •  High-Performance Culture 

 • Customer Focus 

 •  Operational Excellence 

 •  Innovation 

 •  Financial Strength 

 VERTIV BEHAVIORS 

 
 Own it 

 Act with urgency 

 Foster a customer-first mindset 

 Think big and execute 

 Lead by example 

 Drive continuous improvement 

 Learn and seek out development 

 Promote transparent & open communication  

 
 About Vertiv 

 Vertiv (NYSE: VRT) brings together hardware, software, analytics and ongoing services to enable its customers’ vital applications to run continuously, perform optimally and grow with their business needs.  Vertiv solves the most important challenges facing today’s data centers, communication networks and commercial and industrial facilities with a portfolio of power, cooling and IT infrastructure solutions and services that extend from the cloud to the edge of the network. Headquartered in Westerville, Ohio, USA, Vertiv employs around 34,000 people and does business in more than 130 countries. Visit Vertiv.com to learn more.
